theme_and_archetype.visual_vibe: Command-center accuracy for student scholarships, zero fluff, high signal-to-noise ratio, evidence-locked credibility, tactical glassmorphism and cardless grid structure.

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.mono_clause: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-300

layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: section padding py-16 lg:py-24, component gap-6 or gap-8, text-box p-6 sm:p-8
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 p-6

node_styles.active_scholarship: bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-teal-500 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-md
node_styles.compatible_state: bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900 rounded-md p-3
node_styles.review_state: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 rounded-md p-3
node_styles.conflict_state: bg-rose-50 border border-rose-300 text-rose-900 rounded-md p-3

stage_aware_conflict_graph_design.evidence_locked_modal: Fixed overlay with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/60, crisp white modal card with official rule clause box, citation tag, exact gazette date, and direct official portal button.

brand_identity.svg_logo_component: Cap & Keyhole Hybrid SVG Icon with Teal and Navy gradients

key_user_journey_nodes: Landing Page with Vidyadwar Brand Identity
Aarav Sharma Pre-Loaded Demo Profile (CS Undergrad, Income < ₹2.5L)
Document Readiness Assessment (Aadhaar, Income, Marksheet, Caste)
Select Any 2 Scholarships for Side-by-Side Lifecycle Comparison
Evidence-Locked Explanation Drawer (Official Rule / Clause / Date)
Student Decision Outcome (Proceed, Switch, or Alternative Strategy)
Official Portal Redirection with Authority Disclaimer

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select options, tabs, modal triggers, links) MUST contain role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='aarav-demo-button', data-testid='compare-scholarships-button', data-testid='evidence-explanation-modal').
